faq.q: How quickly does a roll-up banner set up?
faq.a: One to two minutes. The panel pulls up onto the aluminium frame, and it packs away just as easily for transport.

faq.q: How long do lightbox LEDs last?
faq.a: Our LED modules are rated for 50,000 hours — roughly five to six years of continuous use. They carry a two-year warranty.

faq.q: What is the difference between an X-banner and a roll-up?
faq.a: An X-banner is cheaper and simpler. A roll-up looks more professional, uses more durable materials and lasts longer.

faq.q: Can I replace a damaged stand panel?
faq.a: Yes. Panels are replaceable — send us the old one and we will produce a new panel to the same size.

faq.q: How many times can a stand system be reused?
faq.a: The aluminium frame lasts indefinitely. A panel starts to show wear after 50–100 uses, which is typically two to three years.
